name: CI: Lint JS (ESLint)
description: GitHub Actions workflow that calls rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows ci-lint-js.yml. Runs ESLint over changed files in a PR, or the whole project on push. Optionally validates package.json shape first. EXPERIMENTAL: the upstream workflow is currently in rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows PR #2 and has not yet shipped on `v1`.

inputs.description: Tag or ref of rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows to call. Workflow is in PR #2 at the time of writing; pin to `v1.0.0/task/ci-lint-workflows` or a commit SHA until the PR is merged.
Run `npm run lint:package-json` before ESLint. Pass 'true' or 'false'.
